notes: §2002:13.6.2 SR5 bars a function formal as a receiving operand. At 2002 that includes CALL ... RETURNING identifier-3 ON OVERFLOW (§2002:14.8.4.2 SR9) and MOVE HIGH-VALUE TO a numeric item (§2002:14.8.24.2 SR4). At --std 2002, g2lk01 and g2lk02 are refused with COBOL2747 at the violating lines, and the legal twin g2lk03 (CALL ... RETURNING W-N ON OVERFLOW and MOVE ALL "7" TO W-N, a digit-only alphanumeric figurative constant into a numeric WORKING-STORAGE item, so no EC-DATA-INCOMPATIBLE per §2002:14.8.24.3 GR4) printed R=00042 N=0041 as derived.
